operating_model.notion_role: Optional documentation/archive; not required for execution

current_product_objective.title: MSH Agent Fabric v1
current_product_objective.summary: Replace loose chat-triggered coordination with a deterministic, policy-governed agent fabric that preserves MSH product context, authority boundaries, evidence, and human gates across GitHub-driven autonomous turns.

architectural_invariants: Nomy owns product priorities, sequencing, scope, acceptance gates, and cross-functional handoffs.
Selah owns engineering implementation, architecture, CI, integrations, iOS/Swift, backend, and technical debugging.
Engineering does not expand beyond the current Product objective without returning to Nomy.
GitHub Issues and PRs are the operational record for MSH work.
Ordinary human-agent conversation should read like conversation, not workflow boilerplate.
A SIEA CHECK is reserved for a real human-only action, decision, credential/access grant, approval, or physical-device step.
Agent-authored events must not recursively trigger autonomous loops.
Consequential execution must be bounded, evidence-backed, and reviewable.
MSH mirrors; Simple helps make sense of it; the person decides.
